prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal incident summaries for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset used to train and evaluate incident-correlation systems. For each incident in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence SUMMARY an SRE would post in an incident channel: what broke, roughly how, and its user-facing effect. Do not invent additional root causes beyond what's implied by the fields given. Vary tone/length across incidents.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"incidents": [{"i": <int>, "summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 150, 'component': 'Alerting Engine', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 151, 'component': 'Network Policy Manager', 'region': 'APAC', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 152, 'component': 'OAuth Authorization Server', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 153, 'component': 'Container Runtime', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 154, 'component': 'Disaster Recovery Orchestrator', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 155, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'ME', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 156, 'component': 'OAuth Authorization Server', 'region': 'EU-West', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 157, 'component': 'Region Failover Controller', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 158, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 159, 'component': 'Client Error Reporting SDK', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 160, 'component': 'Job Scheduler', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 161, 'component': 'CDN Edge Layer', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 162, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 300}, {'i': 163, 'component': 'SSO Broker (Shared)', 'region': 'ME', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 164, 'component': 'SSO Broker (Shared)', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 300}]
